Study portraits from different cultures and periods (e.g., Kahlo, Van Gogh, African masks).
Add meaningful objects or settings to portraits. Develop sketches and mood boards.
Gesture and proportion sketches. Use mannequins or live posing.

Unit 2 · Build environment
Study artists such as Hundertwasser, Paul Klee, and Gaudí. Respond with sketches and mixed media.
Explore repetition and pattern in buildings (tiles, windows). Create abstract pattern studies using paint.
Select areas of previous work or photos and rework them by cropping, enlarging and simplifying.
Complete artwork. Peer critique and reflection using architectural and visual vocabulary.
Begin creating the abstract architectural composition using chosen processes and materials.
Presentation of local and global architecture. Sketch and label geometric forms and textures in buildings.
Use viewfinders to frame parts of buildings (photos or real life). Pencil drawings focusing on line and structure.
Create collage compositions using multiple images. Experiment with layering and transparency.
Use cameras or phones to take photos of local architecture from unusual angles. Print and annotate.
Sketch ideas for abstract final piece. Select media and techniques (paint, collage, digital, etc).
Use pastels, graphite, and pens to represent architectural textures. Frottage and rubbing experiments.
Unit 3 · Design brief
Explore colour theory in design. Test colourways for impact and meaning. Apply to draft posters.
Experiment with combining text and image. Test placement, scaling, and balance. Try alternative arrangements.
Create refined design using chosen media (digital or traditional). Include both poster and logo.
Present examples of posters and logos. Discuss possible issues about theme.
Present final design to class or external audience. Peer critique using design vocabulary.
Collect reference images, explore styles, analyse poster designs. Create mood boards in sketchbooks or digitally.
Experiment with different fonts, hand lettering, and typographic styles. Explore text hierarchy and readability.
